recommendations: Prioritize variable dictionaries, scientific payload formats, and explicit subset-role metadata.
Document processing steps, quality assessments, raw-input lineage, and the software that transformed the released data.
Provide substantive ethics and privacy determinations while preserving the distinction between record evidence and independently supplied applicability context.
Add supported root-series citation, version, conformance, change-history, and relationship metadata without copying child release claims into the parent.
Specify concrete research tasks and document sensitive-content, missing-data, and anomaly assessments.

details.explanation: The NIH functional-genomics and Bridge2AI awards align with the stated cell-architecture and AI-research purposes.
The root license, expanded terms, and separate commercial-licensing statement are compatible.
The nonhuman-subjects declaration is internally consistent with the stated use of commercially available nonclinical cell lines.
Project-wide counts and differing release-level protein counts are explicitly qualified rather than asserted as a single common total.
The description and limitations consistently distinguish current assay data from future computed cell maps.
The record claims deidentified status without documenting a specific method.
Named ethics contacts do not establish that a substantive review or waiver determination is documented.
The June 2026 release's conflicting source year remains disclosed, with the selected date attributed to Dataverse.

correctness_validations.doi_format: No root DOI is present. The supplied release and publication DOIs have plausible DOI syntax and prefixes; registration and resolution were not externally verified.
correctness_validations.grant_number_format: The three structured NIH award identifiers have plausible NIH formats. Institutional support from the Frederick Thomas Fund does not require an invented grant number.
correctness_validations.rrid_format: No RRID is used as the root identifier. Subset descriptions contain RRID:CVCL_B5P3 and RRID:CVCL_0419; these cell-line identifiers are outside the instrument's stated SCR/AB format check and were not used to award E1.1.
correctness_validations.temporal_consistency: Later file publication dates can represent revisions after release publication. The explicit June 2026 source-year disagreement is preserved as a noted-only issue.
correctness_validations.url_validity: The supplied HTTPS project and DOI URLs are structurally plausible. Reachability and external-resource contents were not checked.
